---
title: "Algae Removal"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# Required packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)      # for cov.trob
library(ellipse)   # to produce ellipse points

setwd("C:/Users/aay6/Desktop/Blepharisma_Warming/Bleph_warming_Oct_2023_FlowCytometer/All_data")


# --- Parameters ---
gate_files <- c(
  "FW8Red_Sample77.csv",
  "FW5Red_Sample50.csv",
  "FW8Black_Sample235.csv",
  "FW8Red_Sample76.csv",
  "Nov1_235_Algae.csv"
)
full_data_file <- "All_Flowcytometer.csv"

# Do gating in log10 space (recommended for FCM fluorescence)
use_log10 <- TRUE


# --- Read & combine gate files ---
algae_gate <- rbindlist(lapply(gate_files, fread), fill = TRUE)

# sanitize column names
setnames(algae_gate, gsub("-", "_", names(algae_gate)))

# --- Read full dataset ---
df <- fread(full_data_file)
setnames(df, gsub("-", "_", names(df)))  # sanitize


# --- Optionally transform to log10 space ---
# Value used only when fluorescence is zero or negative,
# because log10 cannot be calculated for those values
pseudo <- 1

transform_data <- function(tb) {
  # copy to avoid modifying original by reference
  tb2 <- copy(tb)
  if (use_log10) {
    # replace zeros / negatives with pseudo to allow log10
    tb2[, FITC_H := ifelse(is.na(FITC_H) | FITC_H <= 0, pseudo, FITC_H)]
    tb2[, PerCP_H := ifelse(is.na(PerCP_H) | PerCP_H <= 0, pseudo, PerCP_H)]
    tb2[, `:=`(FITC_H = log10(FITC_H), PerCP_H = log10(PerCP_H))]
  } else {
    # leave raw values
  }
  return(tb2)
}

algae_gate_t <- transform_data(algae_gate)
df_t <- transform_data(df)

# --- Robust center + covariance from gate points ---
# cov.trob wants a matrix or data.frame with numeric columns
robust_cov <- cov.trob(as.matrix(algae_gate_t[, .(FITC_H, PerCP_H)]))
center <- robust_cov$center
covmat <- robust_cov$cov

# --- Mahalanobis distances for every point in the full dataset (in same space) ---
X <- as.matrix(df_t[, .(FITC_H, PerCP_H)])
md <- mahalanobis(X, center = center, cov = covmat)

# 95% chi-square cutoff for 2 dimensions
cutoff <- qchisq(0.99, df = 2)

# Keep points *outside* the ellipse (i.e., where md > cutoff)
df$mahalanobis <- md        # add to original df for inspection
df$inside_algae_gate <- md <= cutoff

df_noalgae <- df %>% filter(!inside_algae_gate)    # outside = keep

# proportion remaining (and removed)
pct_remaining <- (nrow(df_noalgae) / nrow(df)) * 100
pct_removed <- 100 - pct_remaining

message(sprintf("Points remaining after removing algae: %.2f%% (removed %.2f%%)",
                pct_remaining, pct_removed))

# --- Create ellipse polygon for plotting ---

ell_pts_log <- as.data.frame(ellipse(covmat, centre = center, level = 0.95, npoints = 200))
colnames(ell_pts_log) <- c("FITC_H", "PerCP_H")

# transform ellipse to original units for overlay
if (use_log10) {
  ell_pts_plot <- data.frame(FITC_H = 10^(ell_pts_log$FITC_H),
                             PerCP_H = 10^(ell_pts_log$PerCP_H))
} else {
  ell_pts_plot <- ell_pts_log
}

# --- Plot original with ellipse & after-gating ---

p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 100) +
  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
  geom_path(data = ell_pts_plot, aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H), color = "green", size = 1) +
  { if (use_log10) scale_x_log10() else NULL } +
  { if (use_log10) scale_y_log10() else NULL } +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Full data with algae gate (green)")

p2 <- ggplot(df_noalgae, aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 100) +
  scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis") +
  geom_path(data = ell_pts_plot, aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H), color = "green", size = 1) +
  { if (use_log10) scale_x_log10() else NULL } +
  { if (use_log10) scale_y_log10() else NULL } +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("After removing algae")

# Print plots
print(p1)
print(p2)

# Save df_noalgae
#fwrite(df_noalgae, "All_Flowcytometer_noAlgae.csv")

algae_only <- df %>% filter(inside_algae_gate)
#fwrite(algae_only, "All_Flowcytometer_algaeOnly.csv")

```

Reformatting the plots for publication

```{r}
# ---- Manuscript-ready plots: before and after algal-event removal ----

# Log scales cannot display zero or negative values
df_plot <- df %>%
  filter(FITC_H > 0, PerCP_H > 0)

df_noalgae_plot <- df_noalgae %>%
  filter(FITC_H > 0, PerCP_H > 0)

# Force identical axes in both panels for a direct visual comparison
x_limits <- range(
  c(df_plot$FITC_H, ell_pts_plot$FITC_H),
  finite = TRUE
)

y_limits <- range(
  c(df_plot$PerCP_H, ell_pts_plot$PerCP_H),
  finite = TRUE
)

manuscript_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
  )

# A. All events
p1 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 125) +
  geom_path(
    data = ell_pts_plot,
    aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "#00A087",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = x_limits) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = y_limits) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    trans = "sqrt",
    name = "Event count"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Before algal-event removal",
     x = expression("FITC (" * log[10] * " scale)"),
    y = expression("PerCP (" * log[10] * " scale)")
  ) +
  manuscript_theme

# B. Events retained after removal
p2 <- ggplot(df_noalgae_plot, aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 125) +
  geom_path(
    data = ell_pts_plot,
    aes(x = FITC_H, y = PerCP_H),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "#00A087",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = x_limits) +
  scale_y_log10(limits = y_limits) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    trans = "sqrt",
    name = "Event count"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B. After algal-event removal",
    x = expression("FITC (" * log[10] * " scale)"),
    y = expression("PerCP (" * log[10] * " scale)")
  ) +
  manuscript_theme

p1
p2
```

ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_S2A_before_algal_removal.pdf",

)

ggsave(

  units = "in"
)
